items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: And so the partner said, Johnny, why don't you try something on there? ... Mr. Wakes can tell you about that. Johnny Wakes. Yes, he told us about it.

ctx.x: And so we got there, and they had the whole hand pianos in the barrooms at the time. Uh-huh. So they asked us to play a couple of numbers, the two being half high. I noticed I was reaching to get my drum off of the piano. Uh-huh. So when I was reaching to get my drum off of the piano, half my voice fell in there. And so the partner said, Johnny, why don't you try something on there? Say, see, that's something that we might can make something on. And so, well, in Tiger Rag, when we started to play in Tiger Rag.…
